ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) with a macro-level white-to-black pixel ratio estimated at 0.05:1; high-intensity pixels are limited to sparse punctate regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous dark-intensity region (low RGB values) across approximately 95% of the visible area. Distinct high-contrast white pixel clusters are mapped to the distal portion of the right lobe and scattered near the medial notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate interior pixel angle of 40-45 degrees; the notch vertex is sharply defined and centrally located.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude, chaotic serration map. The left lobe trailing edge features deep, jagged pixel-voids (indentations) representing significant edge fragmentation. The right lobe exhibits a more regular but still jagged series of peaks and valleys.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The right lobe follows a convex sweep trajectory towards the tip. The left lobe trajectory is discontinuous and fragmented, deviating significantly from a standard smooth parabolic curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Presence of multiple small, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters distributed across the right fluke lobe and near the trailing edge of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive structural fragmentation and jagged tissue loss along the trailing edge of the left lobe, indicating substantial past physical trauma and loss of fluke surface area.
other_distinctive_markers: Severe morphological asymmetry between the two fluke lobes due to the irregular, highly eroded appearance of the left lobe's trailing edge compared to the right.
